**3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse** is a specific procedure code used within the Danish healthcare system to identify standard echocardiographic examinations. It plays a critical role in national quality measurement efforts for patients with atrial fibrillation, as tracked by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. 

The code is officially registered in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (National Health Insurance Register), which utilizes a specific set of codes to monitor and standardize cardiovascular care [^src1]. Specifically, it is one of several echocardiography codes used to calculate clinical quality indicators, ensuring that patients receive appropriate diagnostic imaging [^src1]. When tracking the broader medical procedure of [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]], this specific code is used to denote the standard investigation variant [^src2].

In the context of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, the Sygesikringsregisteret contains a defined list of echocardiography codes used for these quality assessments. Alongside 3810, this list includes [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]], [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1]. These codes collectively support the standardized data collection and cross-regional comparison of diagnostic practices for atrial fibrillation patients in Denmark [^src1].
